Come for the Challenge. Stay for the Experience. At HCVT, we believe every challenge presents an opportunity to positively impact our clients and people. Talented and ambitious individuals who seek limitless professional opportunities thrive at HCVT. Our team is known for its technical skill and ability to help clients address complex business issues all while investing in and supporting our people to provide a rewarding employee experience.   What We Do and Who We Serve We offer Tax, Audit, Advisory, and Business Management services to our clients, which include private and public companies, high-net-worth individuals, and family offices. We also specialize in serving clients across the following industries: Private Equity, Real Estate & Hospitality, Media & Entertainment, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Manufacturing & Distribution, Professional Services Firms, Technology, Healthcare, Nonprofit Organizations, and Affordable Housing.     We Live Our Core Values Our values guide us in our day-to-day interactions with our clients and each other—Integrity at our Core; Building Success Together; Passion for Excellence; and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion. We are focused and committed to the needs of our clients and our team.   Discover How Far You Can Go. Opportunities abound at HCVT. Our firm has experienced steady growth since its founding in 1991 and continues to expand its client service offerings, creating new opportunities for professionals to grow their careers. We make significant investments in training and provide interesting, diverse, and intellectually stimulating work for our teams—the kind of work that helps you develop and refine your skills to advance in the profession.    Hybrid Work HCVT currently offers a hybrid work model that allows eligible employees to work both remotely and in the office, based on business needs and team coordination. When working remotely, employees are expected to meet the same performance standards, adhere to the same policies, and maintain the same level of communication, collaboration, and responsiveness as working in the office. Please note that this arrangement is not guaranteed and subject to change at any time. We will strive to provide reasonable notice of any changes to your work location or schedule whenever possible. HCVT's Technology & Transformation practice is seeking an MBA intern to support strategic technology and business transformation engagements for middle-market and private equity-backed clients.

This internship provides an opportunity for MBA students with meaningful professional experience to apply their skills in a consulting environment while gaining hands-on exposure to technology strategy, business process improvement, and digital transformation.

Working alongside experienced consultants, the intern will help assess business challenges, evaluate potential solutions, and develop recommendations that support client transformation initiatives. Engagements may include technology strategy, ERP implementation, data and analytics, AI and automation, process improvement, and change management.

We welcome MBA students with backgrounds in technology, transformation, management consulting, or related fields, as well as professionals seeking to transition into consulting who bring relevant transferable experience.

You will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

  • Support technology and business transformation engagements by analyzing client operations, business processes, and technology environments to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in client interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions to understand business needs, challenges, and objectives.
  • Conduct research and analysis to evaluate potential solutions and support the development of recommendations.
  • Assist in developing technology strategies, business cases, transformation roadmaps, and implementation plans.
  • Support ERP evaluations, system selection, and technology implementation activities, including requirements gathering, solution evaluation, and process design.
  • Research and assess opportunities for AI, automation, data analytics, and process optimization.
  • Prepare client presentations, reports, and other deliverables that communicate findings, insights, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with engagement teams to support project execution, monitor progress, and address project challenges.
  • Contribute to internal practice development initiatives, including research, methodologies, and proposal development.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities to strengthen consulting, analytical, and technical skills.

To be successful, these are the skills, qualities and experience you will need:

  • Previous experience in technology, transformation, management consulting, or a related business function.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional initiatives, technology implementations, or business process improvement projects.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, data analytics, AI, or automation initiatives.
  • Experience conducting business analysis, developing recommendations, or presenting findings to stakeholders.
  • Relevant transferable experience and a demonstrated interest in transitioning into consulting.

285b182f1c0d.title: Civil Design Intern
285b182f1c0d.description_html:
We're looking for Civil Design Interns for 2027. As Civil Design Intern you will be assigned to our Design team. It will include responsibilities typical of a full-time assistant engineer.   You can expect to work on tasks including but not limited to: Performing increasingly responsible engineering work in the design and analysis of innovative stormwater, water resources, and drainage design projects, construction field support and inspection, storm water quality inspection; and perform other duties to support our Design Team. Support innovation in water resources engineering, with emphasis on design of infrastructure that is founded on watershed modeling and performance. Support development of stormwater capture facility conceptual design content, including conceptual drawings and maps, geospatial analysis, hydraulic analysis, and technical writing. Commit to the various duties necessary to advance Craftwater’s qualifications and reputation in the industry   We require our intern to report to our shared workspace 4 times per week in Pasadena, CA. Our in-person time is used to facilitate project collaboration, meetings, professional development & culture. Full-time preferred, flexible schedule, year-round opportunities.

Qualifications

3.5 Minimum GPA Junior school year or higher required. Masters and Doctorate a plus. Civil/Environmental Engineering major preferred. Civil 3D, Microstation, InfoDrainage, ArcGIS Pro, Bluebeam experience a plus.
